summary: Gate precision fixed via PROJECT-LOCALITY guard. New rule (lib/context-gate.js): INJECT iff top1>=0.50 AND empirical AND (margin>=0.12 OR gap>=0.25) AND projectLocality(top note)>=2 — locality counts 4 marker categories on the NOTE: (A) measured quantity tied to observation (%, N/M ratio, "only ~N"), (B) literal error/value (NaN, ERR_*/ENOENT codes, quoted data with digits, error:, exit code), (C) local identifiers (camelCase/snake_case, file paths, calls), (D) observed-on-real-data language (empirically/discovered/observed/measured/real data — "silently" deliberately excluded: winners say "silently misses" but policy notes say "never silently delete"). Separation on live KB: winners note-mq7kyiir6sx=3, note-mq7ydrv353p=4 vs FP notes note-mq780b1f=1 (has scripts/gc-worktrees.js path + bare counts but no %/observed language), note-mq75a81a=0; only ~14% of 161 KB notes score >=2. 9-case confusion: before TP=2 FN=0 FP=2 TN=5 (P=0.50 R=1.00) → after TP=2 FN=0 FP=0 TN=7 (P=1.00 R=1.00); former FPs (wt-gc, tls-local) now abstain reason=non-local. Regression suite committed: test/context-gate-regression.test.js (loads overlay via lib/overlay.js + semantic MiniLM, prints confusion matrix, HARD-FAILS if recall<1.0, precision<1.0 only warns; skips gracefully if model/overlay unavailable). Unit tests 28/28 (21 old preserved-intent + 7 new locality/non-local; reason order keeps locality as last guard so diffuse-match tests unchanged; localityThreshold:0 disables). bench/context-gate-eval.js unchanged-green (scopedRegret=0, sameDomain 2/2 as documented). CAVEAT: n=9 (2 positives) — calibrated with one-category margin each side, not validated; add positives to the suite as they accrue. Only lib/context-gate.js + test files touched; gate has no daemon consumers yet, no restart needed.
